name: Jung Woo Shin
source:
He is a student in the same class as Beumi and suffers from speech impairment and autism. He shows a little obsession with Beumi, who is the only one to be kind. It is said that the lost child prevention tag is worn around the neck, but the address written on it is different, so it is not useful.
[ Translator: [url=https://www.facebook.com/sophroniamoon888/]Sophronia Moon[/url] ]
